description: Source file implementing upstream interface toggling functions for different physical types, including Ethernet, GPON, and WWAN, with utility functions for physical type conversion and validation within a WAN management context.

methods.name: toggle_dummy
methods.description: Default handler for unsupported physical types, logs error and returns -1.

methods.name: toggle_ethernet
methods.description: Enables or disables Ethernet upstream interface.

methods.name: toggle_xpon
methods.description: Enables or disables GPON upstream interface by modifying the interface path.

methods.name: toggle_cellular
methods.description: Enables or disables WWAN cellular upstream interface.

methods.name: string_to_physical_type
methods.description: Converts physical type string to enum value.

methods.name: physical_type_to_string
methods.description: Converts physical type enum to string.

methods.name: phys_type_to_flag
methods.description: Returns flag string for a given physical type enum.

methods.name: physical_reference_used
methods.description: Checks if a physical reference is used in an active WAN mode.

methods.name: toggle_upstream_intf
methods.description: Toggles the upstream interface based on WAN mode and physical type.
